Trees use nested [value,left,right] lists; an empty subtree is None. Return a list of levels from root downward, each in left-to-right order.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      5,
      [
        2,
        null,
        null
      ],
      [
        9,
        [
          7,
          null,
          null
        ],
        null
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      5
    ],
    [
      2,
      9
    ],
    [
      7
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    null
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Process the current queue length as one level.

Complexity: O(n) time and output space
